candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: complete transparent PNG sprite for the pixel-art 2.5D game Loststar.
Input image is the edit target and exact identity/camera/scale/style reference: an old mechanical date stamp, purple bulb handle, short copper shaft, orange brass rectangular roller housing with three purple-marked rollers.
Create state B, AFTER CLEANING but BEFORE mechanical repair. Keep the entire connected object, the exact same three-quarter camera, overall silhouette size, warm upper-left light, fine pixel texture, orange brass/purple palette and centered square framing. The surfaces have been carefully cleaned: no dirt, grit, large ink crust or oxidation patches. HOWEVER the handle and shaft are still visibly tilted approximately 12 degrees left at their attachment; the middle roller is shifted down and crooked, and the right front screw is slightly unseated but remains connected in its hole. This is one recognizable complete stamp, not an exploded diagram and not a pile of spare parts. The B image must visibly have structural faults; do not make it already repaired. Keep printed marks abstract, no new readable records or words. Produce the FULL object as one coherent illustration, no pixel-block patchwork or copied fragments.
Genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, shadow plane, scene, cabinet, glass, tools, hands, captions, frame, glow or floating pieces. Leave transparent breathing room. Output one square image. Preserve high-density pixel illustration; no chunky low-resolution blocks and no photorealism.
candidates.rejectionReason: B1 incorrectly removed exposed-wood varnish wear during cleaning. B2 preserves the same wear, leaning shaft and low crooked roller.

candidates.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the CLEANED but STILL DAMAGED state B of this exact complete game item.
Edit only the surface contamination of this entire purple-handled brass three-roller stamp. Remove the turquoise copper oxidation from the brass, remove dried encrusted ink and gray grime from roller faces and seams, and clean the dirty wood finish. Preserve the two exposed-wood scuffs on the purple handle EXACTLY; cleaning cannot restore missing paint. Preserve the bent leaning handle and shaft, uneven low crooked middle roller, attached screws and complete original structure. No mechanical repair or straightening. Keep the exact camera, viewpoint, dimensions, position, all original abstract purple roller marks and light direction.
The full stamp must remain one coherent standalone illustration, with warm golden brass, purple grip, dark-purple outlines and fine detailed pixel-art game texture. Cleaned surfaces may be brighter but the existing physical wear stays. No patches, new parts, collage, copied fragments, floating dirt or exploded assembly. Output one complete image with genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, backdrop, shadow plane, glass, cabinet, frame, text, hands or tools. Match original image framing and do not crop the item.
candidates.review: root internal static review passed at actual384 on colored background; user visual approval pending
candidates.reason: B1 removed handle wood scuffs; cleaning must not restore worn varnish.
